_note: Joshua edits this via the UI Layout Editor (visual, native). x/y are offsets in canonical pixels from the anchor corner of a 1280x800 reference frame. The game applies positions defensively at startup; a missing/corrupt file changes nothing. FACES (2026-10-17): this file carries two layout faces under "faces" — "mobile" and "desktop" — each with its own full "elements" list. The game (ui_layout_apply.js) applies the face matching the screen it runs on and falls back to the other face, then to the top-level "elements", when a face is missing. The top-level "elements" list is a legacy mirror of the mobile face, kept so older tools keep working. The UI Editor (v1.8.0+) edits one face at a time via its Mobile/Desktop switch and always saves both faces. The mobile face is Joshua's layout exactly as he arranged it; the desktop face started as an exact copy of it. SIZES (2026-10-25): the file also carries a "sizes" list — named screen sizes (Galaxy A17 5G, TCL K33 5G, FOXXD A67L, standard phone/tablet sizes, the laptop class), each with its own full elements list, edited per size in the UI Editor (v1.10.0+). The game applies the size matching the screen's measured visible size (exact, then nearest) before falling back to the faces, then to the top-level elements.
